webSearch.hint: Ordered provider instances the SEARCH and FETCH research tools use — the first one that answers wins. SearXNG rides the SSRF-guarded client; keyed providers (Tavily, Brave, Exa, Serper, Google PSE) ride the guarded POST transport.

connectors.mcpHint: Credentials for external services the assistant's tools call. The GitHub API token raises the repository-lookup rate limit.

sources.title: Job source connectors
sources.hint: Posting ingestion sources through the polite runtime — SSRF-guarded fetches, robots.txt and per-host rate caps enforced. Credentials are sealed at rest and shown as hints only.
sources.queryModeRadarHint: One focused role group per sync, rotating — traffic stays constant however many keywords your radar has.
sources.queryBatchHint: 1 is the safe default — each extra query runs sequentially, with a jittered pause in between.

sources.planSlowHint: A full pass takes over a day — raise Queries per sync or shorten the cadence (Settings → Automations).

extSources.hint: Import connectors from git sources — every install is digest-pinned and consent-gated; updates never auto-apply. Local file-path sources are dev/test only (allowlisted roots).

extSources.enableAria: Enable or pause this installed extension
extSources.gitKindHint: An https git source — pinned ref, digest-checked
extSources.localKindHint: A local git checkout (dev/test only, allowlisted roots)
